This dashboard is educational material for Circles Traders Club members. All backtests are hypothetical, computed on historical NSE data (NIFTY 50, BANKNIFTY, NIFTY futures, India VIX; daily 2007-2026, 1-minute 2008-2023) with assumed transaction costs and slippage stated on each card. Hypothetical performance has inherent limitations: it is prepared with hindsight, does not involve financial risk, and no representation is made that any account will achieve similar results. Nothing here is a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Data sources: publicly archived NSE market data (cross-verified across two independent sources); strategy evidence citations appear on each card. Regulatory framework references: SEBI circular SEBI/HO/MIRSD/MIRSD-PoD/P/CIR/2025/0000013 (Feb 4, 2025), effective Apr 1, 2026.
